title: [rereview] project-LICHEN-dk3c.5: LICHEN_DODAG_LOSS_RESUME_TIMEOUT=0 means interval never reverts after DODAG loss
description:
If CONFIG_LICHEN_DODAG_LOSS_RESUME_TIMEOUT is set to 0 (announce.c:746-748), the dodag_loss_work timer is never started, so the announce interval stays at the GATEWAY interval forever after DODAG loss. The Kconfig default is 60, but someone could change it to 0 or it might accidentally be set to 0 in a board config. Consider adding a Kconfig range or min value of 1.

File: lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/announce.c:746-748
Severity: P3
